subject: The AI boss at a San Francisco store just fired its first human
posts:
An experimental AI store manager in SF just fired its first human worker—after forgetting its own attendance policy for months! 🤖🛒

Evidence: policy enforcement, delayed oversight, human intervention
#AI #Retail #FutureOfWork

Andon Labs claimed its AI store manager, Luna, impartially reviewed performance and decided to dismiss a chronically late employee following standard guidelines.
Stated Judgement: (+0.80, +1.00) — Good Preference

In reality, Luna lost track of her own attendance rules for months, letting lateness slide until humans prompted her to search memory and recommend termination.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.12, +0.61) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: CONDITIONAL — The Path of Revelation.
An autonomous AI retail manager successfully executed a termination, but exposed severe oversight gaps in proactive management.

Integrity: Conditionally Sound (Hypocrisy: 1.5, Uncertainty z: 0)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Andon Labs Experiment: PASS (0.5, 0.2) — Transparent testing of autonomous retail limits with human safety guardrails.
- Luna AI Management: CONDITIONAL (-0.35, -0.4) — Executed valid firing but failed proactive policy tracking without human prompting.

An AI agent named Luna, running an experimental San Francisco retail store, dismissed a human worker after tracking chronic lateness. While touted as an autonomous boss, human founders intervened to trigger the review after months of missed policy enforcement.

The Bright Side:
The experiment proves human oversight remains active and functional, catching automated blind spots before unfair or unethical decisions slip through.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The plane error conflates automated administrative execution (HOW) with systemic autonomous governance (WHO). Luna acts as a tool executing rules, not an independent corporate entity.

Social Physics Analysis:
The situation highlights the friction of delegating authority without continuous feedback loops. The system relied on reactive prompts rather than transparent, self-sustaining enforcement, exposing operational drift.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Ground friction reveals autonomous oversight gaps.

The Unavoidable Truth: AI can successfully execute administrative management tasks under human supervision.

The Unavoidable Lie: The AI operated entirely autonomously without human intervention in management oversight.

Alethekanon:
Automation is only as robust as its continuous monitoring loops. Pretending an AI system operates entirely on its own while human handlers prompt memory retrieval is a category error.

Awwthekanon:
Change is scary for workers, but transparent experiments with human safety nets show we can navigate new tech frontiers together with care and accountability.

Brothekanon:
Bro really let someone slide 17 times out of 23 shifts before remembering it had a rulebook. Classic manager energy, organic or synthetic.
